title: An evening, together
description: A small theatre plan answers every seat choice with a restrained lift and a live reservation total.
useCase: Make a small venue's availability and seat selection legible without burying the experience in checkout chrome.
interaction: Choose up to two available seats
reducedMotion: Selection changes color and check state without lift. Keyboard selections also update immediately.
limitations: Local demonstration with fixed availability and a two-seat limit. Real booking requires server-side holds, live inventory, prices and checkout.
look: Deep burgundy page with three rows of pale-pink outlined seat icons, muted slashed taken seats, a curved stage line and italic serif summary.
motion: Pressing a free seat fills it pale pink and lifts it 3 px (180 ms expo ease-out); hovering previews the lift, and the total updates, capped at two seats.
adapt: The lift is pure CSS: `.sf-seats-shape` transitions `transform` and `background-color`, applied by `aria-pressed=true` and hover. `toggle` enforces the two-seat cap; replace `rows`, `unavailable` and the $48 price with real inventory.
